title: Why one brief beats six handoffs
visualStyle: Photographic still, soft daylight, muted teal and warm wood palette, shallow depth of field, no visible text or logos

segments.narration: Most ads are late for one reason. Not the idea. The handoffs.

cutaways.brief: A long office corridor with three open doors, one showing a room of printers, one a drift of paper planes.

segments.narration: A brief becomes a draft, the draft becomes a resize, the resize waits for review, and review waits for someone to be free. Every wait is a day you do not get back.

cutaways.brief: A desk covered in printed drafts, one marked up in red pen.
A calendar wall with a single day circled and crossed out.

segments.narration: Put the brief in once, review the alternatives side by side, and change only what is wrong.

cutaways.brief: One clean desk, one monitor, a printed brief beside the keyboard.
